ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with localized high-intensity (white) clusters covering approximately 10-15% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling clustered predominantly at the center-left margin adjacent to the notch; sparse, discrete circular white point-clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes; secondary white intensity clustering on the right lobe inner margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a sharp vertex angle; notch depth is approximately 1/8th of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous linear boundary; high-frequency, variable-amplitude peaks and valleys (serrations) along the entire span from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to the distal tips, terminating in jagged, encrusted lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (diameters ranging 5-15 pixels) scattered bilaterally, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical high-intensity linear markings on the right lobe medial section; one diagonal linear disruption on the left lobe near the inner trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular high-intensity scarring patch on the upper-inner quadrant of the left lobe; visible physical erosion and encrustation on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of three-dimensional calcified clusters (barnacles) visible along the dorsal-ventral transition at the fluke tips.
